_comment: C5-PROJ-A source capability / access / lineage census. Governed by docs/PROJECTION_ENSEMBLE_PLAN_2026-08-15.md. This records WHAT EXISTS TODAY and WHAT IS AUTHORIZED, not a plan to build. It authorizes no automation by itself — see accessPosture per entry. Narrative record: docs/projections/C5_PROJ_A_SOURCE_CAPABILITY_CENSUS.md. Loader/validator: src/ros/projection_source_census.py.

evidenceClassNotes.PROJECTION_MODEL: A real per-player projected stat line or fantasy-point projection from a season-long fantasy model.
evidenceClassNotes.DFS_PROJECTION: A daily-fantasy projection, distinguished from salary/ownership/optimizer output or rankings.
evidenceClassNotes.BETTING_MARKET: A sportsbook player-prop line + price, de-vigged before use — never an independent projection-model vote.
evidenceClassNotes.RANKINGS_ONLY: Not one of the plan's three evidence classes. An ordinal ranking, ECR or ADP board with no per-player projected stat line or point total behind it. C5-PROJ-A's own brief requires flagging these explicitly rather than silently admitting them as projections.

accessPostureNotes.PUBLIC_NO_AUTH: No login or credential needed; automation is a straightforward fetch.
accessPostureNotes.CREDENTIALED_SESSION_ALREADY_WIRED: A working authenticated session already exists in this repo for a DIFFERENT product from the same vendor (typically dynasty rankings). Reusing it for a projection endpoint is a session-scope question, not a new credential question.
accessPostureNotes.SUBSCRIPTION_SCOPE_UNRECORDED: The owner reports subscription/account access, but no artifact in this repo records that the subscription's terms permit automated acquisition and internal redistribution of the specific data. Per the governing plan §3: 'Subscription access must not be silently equated with unrestricted automated acquisition/redistribution rights.' Fails closed — does not authorize production automation.
accessPostureNotes.NO_ACCESS_PATH_RECORDED: Owner reports general permission/access is plausible, but no specific authorized endpoint, login, or terms have been recorded. Fails closed.

acquisitionOwnerLanes._comment: docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md §0 (2026-08-20 mass-build campaign) assigns Claude 8 exclusive ownership of new source acquisition and specific named vendor bridges (Dynasty Nerds, Dynasty Dealer, Draft Sharks cross-position, IDP Show / Footballguys acquisition). Claude 11 (C5) consumes existing interfaces and may census/document, but must NOT build new acquisition/auth code for a Claude-8-owned vendor without coordinating first.
acquisitionOwnerLanes.Claude 8: owns new acquisition code for: Draft Sharks (cross-position qualification), IDP Show, Footballguys
acquisitionOwnerLanes.Claude 11: owns: BDVM projection consumption (already exists), the census itself, and acquisition code for vendors NOT named under Claude 8 (CBS, NFL Fantasy, Mike Clay/ESPN, DFS/sportsbook discovery) once an access path is recorded

sources.sourceUrlEvidence: URL pattern documented in src/bdvm/clay_projections.py module docstring — not re-typed here to avoid a second copy of the same fact; see that file.
sources.notes: Already a real, working PROJECTION_MODEL source with raw season stat lines (never the provider's own PPR total), which is exactly what §4/§5 of the ensemble plan require. C5-PROJ-B should reconcile with BDVM's ProjectionRecord schema rather than re-parsing this feed a second way. Forced fumbles are a known coverage gap (omitted, not guessed) — preserve as missing, not zero.

sources.displayName: FantasyPros — true projections page (not ECR rankings)
sources.accessEvidence: Every existing FantasyPros integration in this repo (scripts/fetch_fantasypros_offense.py, fetch_fantasypros_idp.py, fetch_fantasypros_fitzmaurice.py, and the ROS-registered fantasyProsRosSf/fantasyProsRosIdp/fantasyProsRosOverall entries in src/ros/sources/__init__.py) fetches ECR RANKINGS or a trade-value chart — ordinal or value data, not a per-player projected stat line or fantasy-point total. None qualifies as PROJECTION_MODEL evidence under this plan.
sources.notes: IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY, recorded rather than silently carried forward: src/ros/sources/__init__.py's ROS_SOURCES registry marks draftSharksRosSf as is_projection_source: True (see the sibling entry below) while its own module docstring says it currently reads a dynasty RANKINGS CSV as a proxy. That flag predates this census and is a claim about the ROS aggregator's WEIGHT TIER, not a verified statement that raw stat lines are ingested. Not changed here — ROS_SOURCES is a live, consumed registry outside this unit's scope — but future C5-PROJ-B/C work must not treat is_projection_source=True in that registry as proof of PROJECTION_MODEL evidence class without checking the actual adapter.

discoveryLanes.evidence: No DFS provider fetcher, adapter, config entry, or reference exists anywhere in this repo (searched scripts/, src/, config/, Dynasty Scraper.py for dfs/draftkings/fanduel/underdog and found nothing).
discoveryLanes.notes: Plan §3 requires actively looking for weekly DFS projection providers. This census records that the search was performed and found zero existing infrastructure — a real GREENFIELD finding, not an omission. No vendor is named here because none has a recorded, authorized access path; naming an unauthorized vendor/URL would pre-empt that recording step. Next action for whichever session picks this up: record an authorized DFS provider and its access posture BEFORE writing a fetcher, per plan §3's 'record authorized access/automation posture before production ingestion.'
